# Agy Lens **The all-in-one local cockpit & CLI for Antigravity 2.0.**
Exact context window, live tok/s, 5-hour & weekly quotas, implied weekly quota value tracking, and subagent token spend — in one zero-dependency side panel. [![CI](https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Aoike123/agy-lens?label=release)](https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/releases/latest) [![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Aoike123/agy-lens?style=social)](https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/stargazers) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Zero dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-brightgreen) **English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#install-30-seconds) · [What you get](#what-you-get) · [Terminal CLI](#terminal-cli) · [Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
Never get blindsided by a 5-hour wall, silent context trimming, or quiet weekly quota shrinkage again. Agy Lens reads the databases Antigravity already stores on your machine and pairs them with your local language server — zero tokens per refresh, read-only, nothing leaves your computer. ## Why Agy Lens? | | Agy Lens | [desktop-context](https://github.com/dimitr-io/antigravity-desktop-context) | [agy-context](https://github.com/ahmetdotsh/agy-context) + [agy-usage](https://github.com/ahmetdotsh/agy-usage) | Quota-only extensions | | --- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | Context window by category (exact `/context` parity) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | — | | Streaming tok/s, TTFT, cache hit per model | ✅ | — | partial | — | | Official 5-hour **and** weekly quotas with countdowns | ✅ | — | — | ✅ | | Weekly quota implied `$` value & week-over-week shrinkage tracker | ✅ | — | — | — | | Subagent tree rollups, pruned history archive & per-project `% weekly` | ✅ | — | partial | — | | Sanitized share card (SVG / PNG) & terminal CLI | ✅ | — | — | — | | Plugins to install | **1** | 1 | 2 | 1 | | Runtime dependencies | **0** (built-in Node 24) | Python | 0 | IDE extension host | ## Install (30 seconds) You only need the **Antigravity 2.0 desktop app**. It ships Node.js 24 with built-in `node:sqlite`, so there is nothing else to install. **Windows (PowerShell)** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` Then restart Antigravity, turn on **Agy Lens** under **Customizations → Installed**, and open it from the right-side pane of any conversation.
Other ways to install **Antigravity CLI** ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens ``` **Release ZIP (no terminal):** download `agy-lens.zip` from the [latest release](https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/releases/latest) and extract it so that `plugin.json` sits at: - Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-lens\plugin.json` - macOS / Linux: `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-lens/plugin.json` **From source** ```bash git clone https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-lens ``` The installers replace the files atomically and clean up folders left by older versions, so you don't get duplicate panels.
## What you get Each tab owns a distinct view without duplicating controls across pages: | Overview | Quota | History | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Overview](docs/img/en/overview.png) | ![Quota](docs/img/en/quota.png) | ![History](docs/img/en/history.png) | ### Overview: the open conversation - **Context window**, counted the same way as the agy CLI's `/context` from the token data Antigravity records for each model call, not estimated from characters. A 100-dot grid shows the breakdown: user messages, agent replies, tool calls, system prompt, rules, skills, MCP tools and more. - **Request budget** warning before Antigravity starts trimming older history. - **Output speed**: streaming tok/s (outliers filtered), end-to-end speed, time to first token, cache hit rate, recent-call trend, split by model. - **This conversation**: input, output, cache-read and thinking tokens (including live & archived subagents), estimated public-price cost, and its share of your weekly quota (`≈ X% weekly`). ### Quota: before you hit the wall (and track shrinkage) - Official **weekly** and **5-hour** limits for each model pool reported by your plan (such as Gemini, Claude / GPT-OSS, or separate Claude Opus / Sonnet buckets, plus Tab completion), read from the app's local language server, with 20-dot meters and live reset countdowns. - **Implied 100% quota cycle dollar value**: measures true cycle length from consecutive reset timestamps (`last reset − previous reset`, never hardcoding 7 days) and uses in-cycle sample deltas before two resets are observed — scaling partial-usage cycles by actual `%` consumed (with a 5% sample floor and pre-saturation lock so post-limit AI credits don't skew the baseline). - **Cycle valuations & baseline diff chart**: renders an always-open per-pool adaptive `1:1` square-grid bar chart (`This month / 3 months / All`, steady height across densities) with top refresh dates, Peak + Current pool headers, reset & early-reset counts, and current-cycle baseline diff shading (coral-red caps preserving intensity depth above current for shrinkage; borderless soft green fill below current for growth), while keeping unlimited pools (such as Tab completion) cleanly below. - **In-cycle burn-rate drill-down**: click any cycle bar to animate in-place into per-segment burn-rate phases against a weighted baseline, highlighting accelerated `≥ 1.4×` surges alongside peak concurrent conversation counts (`Up to N chats at once`), idle gaps, and off-device usage. ### History: where your tokens went - Desktop **and** CLI conversations across `Today / 7d / 30d / All`, with **segmented time-locked weekly quota totals** that sum official per-cycle usage on each period's own scale alongside unpolled tails and earlier unrecorded calls (`exact` when 100% official, `≈` with breakdown when estimated, plus multi-pool breakdown when active), an adaptive activity heatmap, and **period-scoped model leaderboard** (`By model` updates tokens, cost, and time-locked `X% weekly` to match the selected window). - **Pruned conversation recovery & compaction accounting**: keeps usage after Antigravity deletes old conversation databases (importing older local caches once), resolves checkpoint/compaction model enums across databases, and matches generation timestamps by response ID. - **By session & project grouping**: top-level conversations grouped by Antigravity project (or switched to **Flat** view, with project filter pills in both **By session** and **Session list**), rolling up multi-level subagents, usage-by-level split (`self` vs `subagents`), per-pool dollar breakdown, and **time-locked per-period `≈ X% weekly` sizing** (locked to the cycle/segment prices when each project's calls ran, summing across multi-cycle projects cleanly). - **Share card**: copy a sanitized aggregate usage card (PNG image or SVG) straight to your clipboard with **period-adaptive activity charts** (`Today` 24-hour clock chart, `7d` labeled columns, `30d` bar timeline, `All` calendar heatmap). Conversation titles and file paths are never included. ### Terminal CLI Get the same numbers in your terminal (requires Node.js 24+): ```bash npx github:Aoike123/agy-lens # summary of the latest conversation + history + quota npx github:Aoike123/agy-lens --json # machine-readable output ``` ## Privacy - **Local by default.** All usage and quota numbers come from files and the local language server on your machine. No telemetry, no uploads. - **Read-only.** Conversation databases are opened read-only. The app is never patched; Agy Lens only uses the official plugin/sidecar mechanism. - **Anonymous public checks.** **Sync prices** downloads the public LiteLLM / OpenRouter price list on request, the cached release check queries GitHub Releases every 6 hours for an in-panel update banner (set `AGY_LENS_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` to disable), and clicking **Update now** downloads and SHA-256-verifies the official release ZIP from GitHub (set `AGY_LENS_NO_SELF_UPDATE=1` to disable in-panel updates). No credentials or local data are sent. ## FAQ
The panel doesn't show up under Customizations → Installed Make sure `plugin.json` is directly inside the plugin folder (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-lens/plugin.json`, not nested one level deeper), then fully restart Antigravity.
Quota says "unavailable" Sign in to Antigravity, then turn Agy Lens off and on again so the sidecar receives the language server address and token.
Does it cost tokens or slow the agent down? No. It never calls a model. It only reads local databases and asks the local language server for quota.
Are the dollar amounts or weekly % estimates my exact bill? No. Dollar figures use public API list prices (`≈` marks same-family preview estimates), and implied weekly quota values assume official quota burn scales roughly with local public-price spend — shifts in model mix or usage on other devices can affect the weekly dollar benchmark.
## Contributing Issues and pull requests are welcome, in English or Chinese. The architecture, data sources and protocol notes are in [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md); the dev setup is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ```bash node --test tests/*.mjs # unit tests node tests/e2e/run.mjs # end-to-end suite node scripts/build-release.mjs # build dist/agy-lens.zip ``` If Agy Lens saves you from a rate-limit surprise or helps you size your projects, **give it a ⭐ on GitHub** — it helps other Antigravity users discover it! ## License [MIT](LICENSE). Originally derived from [dimitr-io/antigravity-desktop-context](https://github.com/dimitr-io/antigravity-desktop-context) (MIT).

# Agy Lens **Antigravity 2.0 的一站式本地驾驶舱与终端 CLI。**
精确上下文拆解、实时 tok/s、5 小时与每周额度、100% 周额度总价值追踪与项目级周额度占比 — 一个零依赖侧边面板全部看清。 [![CI](https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Aoike123/agy-lens?label=release)](https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/releases/latest) [![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Aoike123/agy-lens?style=social)](https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/stargazers) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Zero dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-brightgreen) [English](README.md) · **简体中文** · [30 秒安装](#安装30-秒) · [功能一览](#功能) · [终端命令](#终端命令) · [架构文档](docs/architecture.md)
再也不会被 5 小时限额突然卡住，也不会在不知情的情况下被裁掉上下文或悄悄缩水周额度。Agy Lens 直接只读解析 Antigravity 保存在你电脑上的本地数据，并对接本地语言服务器 —— 刷新不消耗任何 Token，数据不出本机。 ## 为什么选 Agy Lens | | Agy Lens | [desktop-context](https://github.com/dimitr-io/antigravity-desktop-context) | [agy-context](https://github.com/ahmetdotsh/agy-context) + [agy-usage](https://github.com/ahmetdotsh/agy-usage) | 仅额度类扩展 | | --- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | 上下文按类别拆解（与 `/context` 同口径） | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | — | | 流式 tok/s、首字延迟、缓存命中（分模型） | ✅ | — | 部分 | — | | 官方 5 小时 **与** 每周额度及重置倒计时 | ✅ | — | — | ✅ | | 100% 周额度美元估值与历周缩水环比监控 | ✅ | — | — | — | | 多级子智能体树汇总、旧对话归档与单项目周额度占比 | ✅ | — | 部分 | — | | 脱敏分享卡片（SVG / PNG）与终端 CLI | ✅ | — | — | — | | 需要安装的插件数 | **1** | 1 | 2 | 1 | | 运行时依赖 | **0**（内置 Node 24） | Python | 0 | IDE 扩展宿主 | ## 安装（30 秒） 只需要 **Antigravity 2.0 桌面应用**。它自带 Node.js 24 和内置的 `node:sqlite`，不用再装任何东西。 **Windows（PowerShell）** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` 然后重启 Antigravity，在 **Customizations → Installed** 中打开 **Agy Lens**，在任意对话右侧边栏打开它即可。
其他安装方式 **Antigravity CLI** ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens ``` **发布包（不用命令行）**：从 [最新发布](https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/releases/latest) 下载 `agy-lens.zip` 并解压，确保 `plugin.json` 位于： - Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-lens\plugin.json` - macOS / Linux：`~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-lens/plugin.json` **源码安装** ```bash git clone https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-lens ``` 安装脚本会原子替换文件，并清理旧版本留下的目录，避免出现重复面板。
## 功能 三个页签职责清晰、互不重复： | 概览 | 额度 | 历史 | | --- | --- | --- | | ![概览](docs/img/zh/overview.png) | ![额度](docs/img/zh/quota.png) | ![历史](docs/img/zh/history.png) | ### 概览：当前对话 - **上下文窗口**：与 agy CLI 的 `/context` 统计方式一致，读取 Antigravity 为每次模型调用记录的真实 Token 数据，而不是按字符估算。100 个点展示用户消息、智能体回复、工具调用、系统提示词、规则、技能、MCP 工具等的占比。 - **请求预算**提醒：在 Antigravity 开始裁剪较早历史之前就能看到。 - **输出速度**：流式 tok/s（已过滤缓冲突发与离群值）、端到端速度、首字延迟、缓存命中率、近期趋势，并按模型拆分。 - **本会话累计**：输入、输出、缓存读取、思考 Token（同时包含在盘及已归档子智能体），按公开价估算的费用，以及本项目占每周额度的比例（`≈ 周额度 X%`）。 ### 额度：限额与周额度价值监控 - 从应用本地语言服务器读取各模型池（如 Gemini、Claude / GPT-OSS 或按套餐拆分的独立 Claude Opus / Sonnet 池，以及 Tab 补全）的官方**每周**与 **5 小时**限额，20 点额度条与实时重置倒计时。 - **100% 周期额度美元估值**：用「上次刷新时间 − 上上次刷新时间」动态计算真实周期长度与起点（不再写死 7 天），首次未记录到相邻两次刷新前先按同周期采样增量估值；即使周期未用满 100% 也按实际消耗比例反算（带 5% 最低用量门槛与饱和前高水位锁，避免用尽后的 AI Credits 污染基准）。 - **历史周期估值与涨跌对照**：各限额池独立展示 `本月 / 三个月 / 全部` 自适应 `1:1` 方格柱状图（切换时段高度保持稳定）、顶部刷新日期、峰值 + 当前估值及刷新/提前刷新次数统计，并以当前期高度为水平基准线进行红/绿涨跌对照（高于当前部分保留深浅层次标红提示缩水，低于当前部分无边框半透明绿标示增长），不限量池（如 Tab 补全）置于底部。 - **周期内分段消耗下钻**：点击任意周期柱子即可原位动画展开该周期的分段消耗速度图与加权基准线，高亮 `≥ 1.4×` 加速时段，并悬停查看同时开启的最多对话路数（`最多同时 N 个对话`）、空闲间隔与其他设备消耗标记。 ### 历史：Token 都花在哪了 - 覆盖桌面端**和** CLI 会话，提供 `今天 / 7 天 / 30 天 / 全部` 汇总与**按各周期自身尺度严格分段相加的周额度统计**（叠加官方实测、周期尾段与早期无记录锚定估算，100% 实测省略 `≈` 并在悬停展示分项明细，多池并行时展示各池明细）、自适应活跃度热力图与**按所选时段同步切片的模型排行**（输入/输出/缓存、费用与按当期锁定的周额度占用）。 - **旧对话归档与精确记账**：自动保留 Antigravity 清理掉的旧会话用量（首次运行还可导入旧缓存）、跨库解析压缩摘要模型枚举，并按响应 ID 精确绑定调用时间戳。 - **按会话（支持按项目归类与筛选）**：顶层主对话支持**按项目分组 / 平铺**切换，并在「按会话」与「会话列表」中提供项目筛选胶囊，汇总各项目及名下多级子智能体树用量、分级对比（自身 vs 子智能体）、分模型池美元明细，以及按调用发生各期单价分段累加的常驻 **`≈ 周额度 X%`** 占用（跨周期对话与项目严格分段相加，不受后续周期涨价回溯影响）。 - **分享卡片**：一键复制脱敏的当前时段聚合用量卡片（PNG 图片或 SVG），**底部活跃图随所选时段自适应切换**（`今天` 按 24 小时时段分布、`7 天` 按周几柱图、`30 天` 带日期刻度、`全部` 多周热力图）；绝不包含对话标题和文件路径。 ### 终端命令 在终端里看同样的数字（需要 Node.js 24+）： ```bash npx github:Aoike123/agy-lens # 最近一次对话 + 历史汇总 + 当前额度 npx github:Aoike123/agy-lens --json # 机器可读输出 ``` ## 隐私 - **默认完全本地**：所有用量与额度数字均来自本机文件与本地语言服务器，没有遥测，不上传任何数据。 - **只读**：会话数据库以只读方式打开；不修改应用本身，只使用官方插件 / sidecar 机制。 - **匿名公开只读请求**：点击 **同步官网价** 时才下载公开价格表；内置更新检查每 6 小时匿名检查一次 GitHub Release 新版本并在面板提示（设置 `AGY_LENS_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` 可关闭）；点击 **立即更新** 后从 GitHub 下载官方发行包并强制校验 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 后自动原地升级（设置 `AGY_LENS_NO_SELF_UPDATE=1` 可禁用面板内更新）。均不发送任何凭据或本地数据。 ## 常见问题
Customizations → Installed 里看不到面板 确认 `plugin.json` 直接位于插件目录第一层（`~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-lens/plugin.json`，不要多套一层），然后完全重启 Antigravity。
额度页显示「暂不可用」 先登录 Antigravity，然后把 Agy Lens 关闭再打开，让 sidecar 重新拿到语言服务器地址和令牌。
会消耗 Token 或拖慢智能体吗？ 不会。它从不调用模型，只读取本地数据库，并向本地语言服务器查询额度。
美元金额和周额度估值是精确账单吗？ 不是。美元金额按公开 API 价格估算（预览模型标 `≈`）；100% 周额度估值基于「官方扣额大致与本机公开价消费成正比」的假设，若不同周期模型搭配变化或存在多设备使用，估值会有正常波动，仅作参考。
## 参与贡献 欢迎用中文或英文提交 Issue 和 Pull Request。架构、数据来源和协议说明见 [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md)，开发环境见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ```bash node --test tests/*.mjs # 单元测试 node tests/e2e/run.mjs # 端到端测试 node scripts/build-release.mjs # 构建 dist/agy-lens.zip ``` 如果 Agy Lens 帮你躲过了一次限额突袭或看清了项目真实用量，欢迎去 GitHub 点个 **⭐ Star**，让更多 Antigravity 用户看到它！ ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)。最初派生自 [dimitr-io/antigravity-desktop-context](https://github.com/dimitr-io/antigravity-desktop-context)（MIT）。

It ships Node.js 24 with built-in `node:sqlite`, so there is nothing else to install. **Windows (PowerShell)** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` Then restart Antigravity, turn on **Agy Lens** under **Customizations → Installed**, and open it from the right-side pane of any conversation.
Other ways to install **Antigravity CLI** ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens ``` **Release ZIP (no terminal):** download `agy-lens.zip` from the [latest release](https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens/releases/latest) and extract it so that `plugin.json` sits at: - Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-lens\plugin.json` - macOS / Linux: `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-lens/plugin.json` **From source** ```bash git clone https://github.com/Aoike123/agy-lens.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-lens ``` The installers replace the files atomically and clean up folders left by older versions, so you don't get duplicate panels.
## What you get Each tab owns a distinct view without duplicating controls across pages: | Overview | Quota | History | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Overview](docs/img/en/overview.png) | ![Quota](docs/img/en/quota.png) | ![History](docs/img/en/history.png) | ### Overview: the open conversation - **Context window**, counted the same way as the agy CLI's `/context` from the token data Antigravity records for each model call, not estimated from characters. A 100-dot grid shows the breakdown: user messages, agent replies, tool calls, system prompt, rules, skills, MCP tools and more. - **Request budget** warning before Antigravity starts trimming older history. - **Output speed**: streaming tok/s (outliers filtered), end-to-end speed, time to first token, cache hit rate, recent-call trend, split by model. - **This conversation**: input, output, cache-read and thinking tokens (including live & archived subagents), estimated public-price cost, and its share of your weekly quota (`≈ X% weekly`). ### Quota: before you hit the wall (and track shrinkage) - Official **weekly** and **5-hour** limits for each model pool reported by your plan (such as Gemini, Claude / GPT-OSS, or separate Claude Opus / Sonnet buckets, plus Tab completion), read from the app's local language server, with 20-dot meters and live reset countdowns. - **Implied 100% quota cycle dollar value**: measures true cycle length from consecutive reset timestamps (`last reset − previous reset`, never hardcoding 7 days) and uses in-cycle sample deltas before two resets are observed — scaling partial-usage cycles by actual `%` consumed (with a 5% sample floor and pre-saturation lock so post-limit AI credits don't skew the baseline). - **Cycle valuations & baseline diff chart**: renders an always-open per-pool adaptive `1:1` square-grid bar chart (`This month / 3 months / All`, steady height across densities) with top refresh dates, Peak + Current pool headers, reset & early-reset counts, and current-cycle baseline diff shading (coral-red caps preserving intensity depth above current for shrinkage; borderless soft green fill below current for growth), while keeping unlimited pools (such as Tab completion) cleanly below. - **In-cycle burn-rate drill-down**: click any cycle bar to animate in-place into per-segment burn-rate phases against a weighted baseline, highlighting accelerated `≥ 1.4×` surges alongside peak concurrent conversation counts (`Up to N chats at once`), idle gaps, and off-device usage. ### History: where your tokens went - Desktop **and** CLI conversations across `Today / 7d / 30d / All`, with **segmented time-locked weekly quota totals** that sum official per-cycle usage on each period's own scale alongside unpolled tails and earlier unrecorded calls (`exact` when 100% official, `≈` with breakdown when estimated, plus multi-pool breakdown when active), an adaptive activity heatmap, and **period-scoped model leaderboard** (`By model` updates tokens, cost, and time-locked `X% weekly` to match the selected window). - **Pruned conversation recovery & compaction accounting**: keeps usage after Antigravity deletes old conversation databases (importing older local caches once), resolves checkpoint/compaction model enums across databases, and matches generation timestamps by response ID. - **By session & project grouping**: top-level conversations grouped by Antigravity project (or switched to **Flat** view, with project filter pills in both **By session** and **Session list**), rolling up multi-level subagents, usage-by-level split (`self` vs `subagents`), per-pool dollar breakdown, and **time-locked per-period `≈ X% weekly` sizing** (locked to the cycle/segment prices when each project's calls ran, summing across multi-cycle projects cleanly). - **Share card**: copy a sanitized aggregate usage card (PNG image or SVG) straight to your clipboard with **period-adaptive activity charts** (`Today` 24-hour clock chart, `7d` labeled columns, `30d` bar timeline, `All` calendar heatmap). Conversation titles and file paths are never included. ### Terminal CLI Get the same numbers in your terminal (requires Node.js 24+): ```bash npx github:Aoike123/agy-lens # summary of the latest conversation + history + quota npx github:Aoike123/agy-lens --json # machine-readable output ``` ## Privacy - **Local by default.** All usage and quota numbers come from files and the local language server on your machine. No telemetry, no uploads. - **Read-only.** Conversation databases are opened read-only. The app is never patched; Agy Lens only uses the official plugin/sidecar mechanism. - **Anonymous public checks.** **Sync prices** downloads the public LiteLLM / OpenRouter price list on request, the cached release check queries GitHub Releases every 6 hours for an in-panel update banner (set `AGY_LENS_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1` to disable), and clicking **Update now** downloads and SHA-256-verifies the official release ZIP from GitHub (set `AGY_LENS_NO_SELF_UPDATE=1` to disable in-panel updates). No credentials or local data are sent. ## FAQ
The panel doesn't show up under Customizations → Installed Make sure `plugin.json` is directly inside the plugin folder (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-lens/plugin.json`, not nested one level deeper), then fully restart Antigravity.
Quota says "unavailable" Sign in to Antigravity, then turn Agy Lens off and on again so the sidecar receives the language server address and token.
Does it cost tokens or slow the agent down? No. It never calls a model. It only reads local databases and asks the local language server for quota.
Are the dollar amounts or weekly % estimates my exact bill? No. Dollar figures use public API list prices (`≈` marks same-family preview estimates), and implied weekly quota values assume official quota burn scales roughly with local public-price spend — shifts in model mix or usage on other devices can affect the weekly dollar benchmark.
